soundness_flags.label: ass:observable-outcome-variance
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited known-cutoff condition is a nondegeneracy condition for the null-restricted residual used by bias-aware AR inversion, not the proposal's pointwise lower bound on Var(Y|X=x); retag and justify this distinct condition, or state the residual condition actually needed.

soundness_flags.label: thm:global-profile-separation
soundness_flags.one_line: “Population Bernoulli profile loss” is never defined as a functional and C_sep is circularly introduced as a constant derived by the theorem that uses it, so the displayed lower bound has no determinate left-hand side or quantified constant.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper's honesty theorem is for its bias-aware null-restricted inversion and Assumption 1(iii) imposes variance nondegeneracy for that null-restricted regression quantity; it does not state the proposal's standalone all-x lower bound on Var(Y|X=x).

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define the population treatment-profile loss explicitly (including its optimization domain and reference split), and replace the circular C_sep declaration with an existential constant depending only on stated primitives.

Either use the residual-variance/nondegeneracy condition required by the intended four-cell inversion or retag the outcome-variance condition as novel and give a substantive administrative-data justification plus an a.e.-in-x version convention.

Sharpen the recovered-regime target into an explicit first nontrivial unknown-cutoff fuzzy-RD upper/lower comparison, stating the grid/sieve sequences and the exact error terms needed for continuum transfer.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two soundness defects, then return this field-tier unknown-cutoff fuzzy-RD frontier to novelty review.
